environment.description: Flask application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) behind an Application Load Balancer with default settings. ALB forwards all traffic on port 443 to target group on port 8080. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or filtering. The application serves the internal user directory for a SaaS platform. API keys are distributed to partner integrations.

config.alb_rules: Default action: forward to target group, no additional rules
